material.description: Blocker for gap-mod-unit-id-mapping-blocker-gm-oscraft-sc2-alt-1-m10. Checked on main head b8b7b1b4 (rust/crates/server/src/room.rs and rust/crates/mod-host/src/lib.rs clean in git_status). Finding: the requested fix is already present. room.rs:342-345 apply_mod_commands applies Cmd::Spawn at the tick boundary, binds handle to the sim unit returned by sim.spawn (Option<usize>), and emits Ev::ModUnitBound with handle and unit. Cmd::Spawn already carries handle (mod-host lib.rs:72). Residual gap, unchanged from the parent row: the mod never receives the id, because mod-host lib.rs:736 cmd_spawn returns nothing and the local apply_commands (lib.rs:1149-1150) discards the index. Live witness NOT run: no local server probe executed, so no dispatch id exists. Needed: a live probe through gm exec dispatch that spawns via a mod and asserts ModUnitBound unit for a handle, plus a decision on how the mod receives the id (mod-side handle return or room-to-mod feedback). No code edited, no push.
material.subject: ModUnitBound already binds at apply time; mod never receives the id; live probe not run
material.witness: served room, mod game.cmd_spawn: ev=mod_unit_bound handle=1 unit=30 (witness-log line, RESULT: PASS). Default decision: mod reads its unit id from ModUnitBound, no new channel.
